text: Consider how consumer surplus relates to what consumers are willing versus what they pay for goods and services in a market setting. Reflect on this difference as an expression of economic benefit or gain from participating in transactions within that market.
Consider how consumer surplus relates to individual buyer's willingness and actual payment for goods in competitive markets. Reflect on where this difference lies within your options.

Consumer surplus occurs when consumers pay less than what they are willing to pay for goods or services. It represents a gain in consumer welfare from market transactions. To find where it fits among your options: think about who benefits and how the price paid relates to their valuation of the product.
